anchor: Plan v26 Phase B.2 — neighborhood scheme per city. Founder direction: prefer the BIGGER chunks ('the five big neighborhoods should be the separation'). Default scheme = 5 cardinal macro zones (Central, North, South, East, West) for cities without a canonical 5-7 chunk subdivision. Cities with a well-known macro division (NYC 5 boroughs, Paris Right/Left Bank, Tokyo 5 wards zone aggregate, London 5 zones) get explicit overrides.
convention: Each city: scheme ∈ {α-macro, β-subdivisions, γ-none}. neighborhoods = list of {slug, name, character, description?}. character ∈ {central-business, affluent-residential, mid-residential, working-residential, industrial, tourist, mixed-urban, academic}. Synthesis multiplies city-level data by (industry, character) multiplier (see character_multipliers_v1.json).
default_scheme_for_tier1_and_tier2: α-macro with 5 cardinal zones — only when no canonical division is recorded below.

neighborhoods.name: Manhattan, FiDi
neighborhoods.description: Wall Street + Financial District. Banks, law firms, corporate HQs. Almost no residents.

neighborhoods.name: Manhattan, Midtown
neighborhoods.description: Midtown East + Midtown West. Office towers, theatres, hotels, transit. Tourist + commuter spike.

neighborhoods.name: Manhattan, Upper East Side
neighborhoods.description: Premium residential, Museum Mile, embassies, luxury retail on Madison Ave.

neighborhoods.name: Manhattan, Upper West Side
neighborhoods.description: Established residential, Central Park west, Lincoln Center, Columbia U adjacent.

neighborhoods.name: Manhattan, SoHo / TriBeCa
neighborhoods.description: Cast-iron architecture, designer flagships, tourist destination, high net worth residential.

neighborhoods.name: Manhattan, Harlem
neighborhoods.description: Historic Black Manhattan, gentrifying edge, restaurants reviving along Frederick Douglass Blvd.

neighborhoods.name: Brooklyn
neighborhoods.description: Mixed residential, creative industries, growing tech and food scenes.

neighborhoods.name: Queens
neighborhoods.description: Diverse mid-class residential; airport-anchored services; small manufacturing.

neighborhoods.name: The Bronx
neighborhoods.description: Working-class residential; value retail; small-trade economy.

neighborhoods.name: Staten Island
neighborhoods.description: Suburban residential, lower density, family-business economy.

neighborhoods.name: City of London
neighborhoods.description: Square Mile financial district. Banks, insurance, legal. Commuter intensity ~8x.

neighborhoods.name: West End
neighborhoods.description: Soho, Covent Garden, Mayfair, Oxford St. Tourism, theatre, luxury retail, embassies.

neighborhoods.name: South Bank
neighborhoods.description: Southbank Centre, Borough Market, London Bridge. Cultural + tourist + workplace mix.

neighborhoods.name: North London
neighborhoods.description: Islington, Camden Town, Hampstead — creative, residential, hospitality.

neighborhoods.name: South London
neighborhoods.description: Lambeth, Southwark, Greenwich — mixed residential and emerging business.

neighborhoods.name: East London
neighborhoods.description: Tower Hamlets, Hackney, Stratford — tech, creative, and rapid regeneration.

neighborhoods.name: West London
neighborhoods.description: Kensington, Chelsea, Hammersmith — premium retail and residential.

neighborhoods.name: Louvre / Marais
neighborhoods.description: 1st-4th arrondissements. Louvre 9M tourists/year, Marais boutiques, Les Halles transit.

neighborhoods.name: Champs-Élysées / Opéra

neighborhoods.name: Saint-Germain / Latin Quarter

neighborhoods.name: North Periphery
neighborhoods.description: 18th-20th arrondissements and outer ring. Montmartre tourism + working residential mix.

neighborhoods.name: South Periphery
neighborhoods.description: 13th-15th arrondissements. Station F, university campuses, tech corridor.

neighborhoods.name: Central Tokyo
neighborhoods.description: Chiyoda, Chuo, Minato — financial heart, headquarters, premium hospitality.

neighborhoods.name: West Tokyo
neighborhoods.description: Shinjuku, Shibuya, Setagaya — retail, nightlife, creative, residential mix.

neighborhoods.name: North Tokyo
neighborhoods.description: Toshima, Bunkyo — universities, residential, mid-scale commerce.

neighborhoods.name: East Tokyo
neighborhoods.description: Sumida, Koto, Edogawa — traditional small business and workshops.

neighborhoods.name: South Tokyo
neighborhoods.description: Shinagawa, Ota, Meguro — residential, light industrial, airport corridor.

neighborhoods.name: Mitte / Central
neighborhoods.description: Mitte, Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg — government, startups, tourism.

neighborhoods.name: West Berlin

neighborhoods.name: East Berlin
neighborhoods.description: Prenzlauer Berg, Lichtenberg — gentrified mid-residential, creative.

neighborhoods.name: Outer Berlin
